# Batch 1 expansion QA — 2026-11-05

## Method
- Each rendered package was served locally with Python's http.server on 127.0.0.1:4177.
- Playwright Chromium screenshots at 390px and 1280px for every page.
- Overflow = document scrollWidth minus clientWidth.
- Header height and main width captured from the rendered DOM.
